sources: Placeholder numbers: this file only shows what each scene type looks like. Replace everything.

lines.text: This gallery shows every scene type the engine can draw, one after another.

scene.title: Scene *Gallery*
scene.sub: Every scene type, one by one

lines.text: A text scene is the simplest way to state one big idea.

scene.headline: One *big* idea, stated plainly
scene.sub: A headline, an optional supporting line and an optional icon.

lines.text: Kinetic type makes the key words land exactly when they are spoken.

scene.text: Kinetic type lands each *word* exactly when it is *spoken.*

lines.text: A callout interrupts the pattern and wakes the viewer up.
Stat scenes count up to a number, which is great for a surprising figure.
Or a percentage, drawn as a ring.
Bar charts grow in on the words you choose, one bar at a time.
Horizontal bars suit rankings and long labels.
Line charts draw a trend across time.
And a donut chart shows how a whole is split.
Bullets walk through a list, revealing each point on its own word.

items.text: A second point with a sub-line

lines.text: Comparisons set two sides against each other.
A flow shows how one step leads to the next.
Flows can also run vertically.
Icon grids introduce a few related ideas at once.
A split scene pairs one icon with a statement.

scene.headline: One icon, one *statement*
scene.sub: Good for introducing a person, place or concept.

lines.text: Timelines place events in order and scroll when there are many.
Maps zoom in on a region and mark places and journeys.
The world view works for global stories.
Quotes put a short line from someone in the spotlight.

scene.quote: A short, memorable line goes here, set large and with room to breathe.

lines.text: Countdown cards make ranked lists easy to follow.

scene.title: The third entry
scene.sub: A line explaining why it earned this spot.

lines.text: Your own images get a slow camera move.

scene.caption: Your photo here
scene.credit: Credit: you or the licence holder

lines.text: And a closing card ends the film.
